paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Rehoboam in gam aphutkip a, mihattak ahong hih nung in amah lam a pang Israel tengteng toh TOUPA Pan alehngatsan uhi.
heading: Aiguptate'n Judah Dou / (1 Kum 14.25-28)

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa Rehoboam vaihawm akum ngana kum in, TOUPA tung a atatlek ziak un, Jerusalem sim ding in Aigupta kumpipa Shishak ahong kuantou hi,
Kangtalai singkhat-le-sangnih leh sakol tungtuangmi singguk toh, Aigupta gammi hon zuite sim vual louh ahi uh; Libiate, Sukite, Ethiopiate ahi uhi.
Judah gam a kulh nei khopite ala a, Jerusalem ava tung hi.

Rehoboam leh Judahte intekpen, Shishak ziak a Jerusalem a kikaikhawmte kiang ah zawlnei Shemaiah ahohtou a, akiang uah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi, na hon lehngatsanta ua, huaiziak in ke'n leng noute Shishak khut ah ka hon koihta ahi achi," ava chi hi.
Huchi in Israel intekpen leh kumpipa akiniamkhiak ua, "TOUPA adiktat hi," achi uhi.

TOUPA'N akiniamkhiak uh atheih in TOUPA thu Shemaiah kiang ah ahong tung a, "Akiniamkhiakta ua; ka hihmang vek kei ding a, khenkhat ka humbit ding a, Shishak zang in Jerusalem tung ah ka hehna ka sungbo kei ding.
Himahleh asikhate ahi ding ua, ka nasep leh gamdangmi nasepdan atheihna ding un," chi in.
Huchi in Aigupta kumpipa Shishak Jerusalem sim in apaitou a, TOUPA' inn a goute leh kumpipa' inn a goute ala a; ala khin vek hi; Solomon bawl dangka-eng lumte leng ala hi.
Kumpipa Rehoboam in huaite tang in dal lumte abawl a, kumpipa' inn kongkhak ngakmi sepaih heutute akemsak hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa TOUPA' inn a lut teng in veng mite'n ava pi ua, amah dantan ah akhakik nawn zel uhi.
Akiniamkhiak ziak a hihmanthat ahihlouhna ding in atung a TOUPA thangpaihna akiheimangta a; Judah gam leng ahoih gige hi.

Huchi in kumpipa Rehoboam in avaihawmna Jerusalem ah akipsakta hi: Rehoboam in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmli-le-khat a upa ahi, TOUPA'N amin omsakna ding a Israel nam tengteng lak a atel khopi Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-sagih vai ahawm a; anu min Naamah, Ammon mi ahi.
heading: Rehoboam Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna

paite: TOUPA zong dia alungsim azat louh ziak in thil hoih lou ahih hi.

Huchi in Rehoboam tanchin abul a kipan atawp pha in zawlnei Shemaiah gelh tanchinbu ah leh zawlnei Iddo gelh tanchinbu a suante tanchin lak a gelh ahi kei maw? Rehoboam leh Jeroboam bel a kidou nilouh uhi.
Huan Rehoboam api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, David khua ah avui ua: asik in atapa Abijah in vai ahawm hi.
